items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Generic of a boy named Frank Downley. He's a wonderful fellow.

ctx.x: In my heyday, I wore only Stein Rock. Dobbs hats. I still nut on hats. I pick $18, $20 per hat. Well, you can't get a decent hat. I'm right now debating what hat I'm going to wear with my sport coat. I've got to please my daughter. And this one. This girl, is she on the ball? Oh! Generic of a boy named Frank Downley. He's a wonderful fellow. He's in electronics, not in Houston. Making plenty of money. She threw away 28 shirts more to her dad. Because they were out of style. Well, he can afford them. He has four…

And they round dance and they do this, that and the other. I'm not going to interfere in their life. You know what I mean? Look at that stationery, the groom hall. This is a photostatic copy, you know? Now tell me when it starts to talk.
